figures.title: Общий вид и сечения A-A зажима НМЗ
figures.description: Side view of the clamp: L is overall length across the entire clamp; L1 is measured from the left rope-entry end toward the press zone; L2 measures the loop/eye portion at the right; d is marked at the left rope entry; d1 is marked at the loop; A marks the location of section A-A. Below: two section A-A views. Исполнение 1: circular section showing d and D. Исполнение 2: flattened section showing d, B (width) and D (height). No numeric dimension values are printed on the drawing itself; dimension values come from the table. Ambiguity: exact endpoints of L1 and A are read from leader lines at moderate resolution.

source_notes: Footer: 110, ООО «МЗВА-ЧЭМЗ», Тел./ факс: +7 (495) 780-51-65, e-mail: zakaz@mzva.ru, www.mzva.ru
uncertainties: Merged-cell boundaries inferred from cell borders; values shown once per merged span were assigned to the first row of the span with other rows marked blank.
Исполнение column: '1' appears merged over the НМЗ-45…НМЗ-120 and НМЗ-135…НМЗ-200 blocks, '2' over НМЗ-240…НМЗ-350; exact span of the first '1' partially covered by canonical table showing blanks.
Разрушающая нагрузка for НМЗ-110/120 group shows 250; per canonical table this spans the merged group.
Possible typographical anomalies (НМЗ-180-2 grade '-170'; НМЗ-240-1 L=50; НМЗ-350-3 L1=29) transcribed literally.
Small dimension labels on drawing (d, d1, A endpoints) read at moderate image resolution.
